test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The solution is **wondered**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5, "They looked at the planets and (5)_______ at what they saw." is wondered.
 
• They looked at the planets and wondered what they saw.
 
• Here the word **wondered **is used because the action was done in the past.
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:
 
 
• **Stunned - **So shocked that one is temporarily unable to react; astonished.
 
• **Surprised - **Feeling or showing surprise.
 
• **Shocked - **Surprised and upset.
